faqs.question: Can restaurant POS software handle dine-in, takeaway and delivery orders?
faqs.answer: Yes. Staff can create orders for each service type and manage the kitchen and billing workflow. Delivery orders are entered by staff; they are not imported from delivery platforms.

faqs.question: Can guests split a bill or pay in different ways?
faqs.answer: Yes. Eligible unissued items can be arranged into separate draft bills. You can also record several payment methods against one bill. Splitting a bill and splitting a payment are separate actions.

faqs.question: Can I manage menus across several outlets?
faqs.answer: Prepare a central menu, review and publish changes, then apply the publication to selected outlets. Outlets can also keep independent menus. Team access is scoped to the outlets they handle.

faqs.question: Can I add delivery or packaging charges?
faqs.answer: Set flat defaults and edit permitted charges for an order. Delivery charges apply to delivery orders; packaging can be selected where applicable. Refund handling follows the configured policy.

faqs.question: Does it support GST billing and UPI?
faqs.answer: You can configure tax profiles, preview bill tax lines and record UPI, cash or card collections. Payment recording does not automatically verify bank settlement. GST filing and payment-gateway integrations are outside this offer.

faqs.question: What about devices, printers and delivery platforms?
faqs.answer: Confirm your devices and bill or kitchen-ticket printers during the demo. Printing needs compatible hardware and local setup. Delivery orders are entered by staff; automatic delivery-platform imports are not included.

faqs.question: What does RestaBee restaurant POS software include?
faqs.answer: Orders, kitchen tickets, table service, billing, menu management, reports and team access are available in one workspace. Request a demo to review the workflows that matter to your restaurant.

faqs.question: What should POS software for restaurant operations cover?
faqs.answer: It should carry the order through table service, kitchen preparation, billing and payment records. RestaBee connects those steps in one workspace.

faqs.question: How do restaurant POS systems support more than one outlet?
faqs.answer: RestaBee lets teams prepare central menu changes, publish them to selected outlets and scope access to the outlets each person handles.

faqs.question: What should a restaurant POS system make easier to manage?
faqs.answer: Teams can review tables, orders, kitchen progress, bills, collections and outlet reports from their assigned workspaces.

faqs.question: How do I get started?
faqs.answer: Request a demo and share your restaurant name, city, outlet count and the service workflow you want to review. You can discuss your intended devices and printer setup during the conversation.
